item1.title: Receive transport tasks and start your journey with confidence
item1.body: Easily receive new transport requests and view all task details, including the pickup location and destination.

item2.title: Track all your trips and tasks in one place
item2.body: View your daily trip schedule and monitor the status of each task in real time, with quick access to trip details and pickup and delivery information.

item3.title: Complete transport operations efficiently and arrive on time
item3.body: Carry out transport trips safely and easily, complete the delivery process in just a few simple steps, and instantly update the task status to ensure a professional and reliable operational experience.
